reference.title: Scenario 18 — Table Between Numbered List in a Workflow

section.p: Consider a workflow represented as a numbered list where the author inserts a reference table between lifecycle stages.

row.entry: [Heading 2]: Deployment Environment Lifecycle [Normal]: The following workflow shows the deployment lifecycle. [List Number]: Development Environment [Caption]: Environment responsibilities [Table Header]: Environment │ Purpose [Row]: Development │ Feature implementation [Row]: Staging │ Pre-production validation [List Number]: Staging Environment [List Number]: Production Environment

entry.codeblock:
Deployment Environment Lifecycle

The following workflow shows the deployment lifecycle.

  1. Development Environment Environment responsibilities Environment Purpose Development Feature implementation Staging Pre-production validation
  2. Staging Environment
  3. Production Environment

section.p: Result: The converter treats the inserted table as content inside the numbered workflow structure and the table is nested inside the preceding <li> and the list stays as a single, unsplit <ol>.
